title: Hackers abuse npm mirrors to host phishing redirect pages
summary: OX says this technique effectively turns npm mirrors into "free frontend hosts for malicious HTML pages and potentially other payloads as well." The malicious HTML impersonates a Cloudflare security verification page that embeds Cloudflare's legitimate Turnstile CAPTCHA service.
